text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono! Happy birthday!! We're gonna 
celebrate a whole bunch today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono always cooks such delicious meals for 
us, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To defeat evil, you need the power of 
justice! Bono's cooking is packed with 
nutrition, so we're good to go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm so happy~! In that case, I've 
gotta prepare a ton of food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of power, chanko nabe is a must! 
And let's grill some meat too! And 
then~...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Wouldn't that make it feel like I'm 
the one being celebrated instead of Bono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine~! As long as Biko-chan 
eats her fill, that brings world peace 
right there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I eat a lot, world peace will come... 
D-Do I have to eat the celery too?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! I-I'll do my best. A hero isn't 
allowed to be a picky eater!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! With this, we're one step closer to 
world peace☆
